subject: maths
question: A man travelled a distance of 54 km in 4 hours, partly on foot at 6 km/h and partly on bicycle at 18 km/h. Find the distance (in km) travelled on foot.
solution:
**Given:**

Total traveled distance = 54 km

Total time taken to travel = 4 hours

Traveled a part by foot at 6 km/h 

Traveled a part by bicycle at 18 km/h 

**Concept used:**

Distance = Speed × Time&
